description:
Mysterious cosmic forces have created the Fightland, and they’ve plucked warriors from all across space and time to do battle in this fun, frantic action combat game. Split into 4 teams of up to 25 players each to scout for advantage, defend your positions, conquer objectives, and emerge victorious!

From the makers of Bloons TD 6 comes a brand new IP and brand new game genre - the massive team battle arena game. We love MOBAs, Battle Arenas, and team combat games, and Fightland's goal is to keep the large team combat intensity high for the whole match. Whether you are playing offense or defense, your team needs your individual skill and excellent squad coordination to deliver victory.

CONSIDER YOUR STRATEGY
Three dynamic victory conditions keep gameplay fresh and varied:
- Last Base Standing: defend your base while effectively striking the other 3 enemy bases
 - Crystal Carry: escort precious crystals to your base but be aware there are two crystals in play at once - can your team defend and deliver both?
 - Fightzone: capture and hold a single territory that shifts to varied map positions but remains the single point where all teams converge to fight in huge hilarious scrums

CHOOSE YOUR CLASS
Going the Brute path gives you access to heavy-hitting, crowd-clearing weapons. With Rogue, you are fast on your feet, delivering quick, precision attacks. As a Mage, you can damage enemies at range, heal your allies, or join the fray directly!

BUILD YOUR LOADOUT
Each of the 3 classes has bespoke Secondary items and armored Outfits to further specialize your build. Secondaries focus on defense and crowd control, and Outfits enhance one or more stats for fun combinations with Weapons and Secondaries.

MASTER YOUR WEAPONS
Upgrade your base weapons to Mastery level, which evolves functionality in at least one key area. Mastered Weapons are balanced as a group, and their different specialties unlock new playstyles and stunning new visuals.

Enough reading - time for fighting! In Fightland! See you in the skirmish!

**********
Ninja Kiwi Notes:
Fightland is free to download and play, and all in-game items and levels are available to unlock via in-game play and in-game currency collection and rewards. Please note that all items can also be fast unlocked using in-app purchases using real money.
Please review our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. You will be prompted in-game to accept these terms in order to cloud save and protect your game progress.
short_description: Mysterious cosmic forces have created the Fightland, and they’ve plucked warriors from across space and time to do battle there. Join with up to 100 other players in this massive team battle arena game where individual skill, squad tactics, and overall teamwork will determine the victor!
requirements:
Минимальные:
64-разрядные процессор и операционная система

ОС: Windows 10 (64bit)

Процессор: 1.5Ghz or better (x86-64)

Оперативная память: 4096 MB ОЗУ

Видеокарта: OpenGL 2.0 compatible, AMD, Nvidia or Intel HD

Место на диске: 2 GB

Звуковая карта: Windows compatible sound card
